sequence.error: lax.dynamic_update_slice requires arguments to have the same dtypes, got float32, bfloat16.

root_cause: The first generated latent was float32 and was concatenated into the bfloat16 context buffer. That promoted the retained context to float32, so the next rollout created float32 KV-cache buffers while the model produced bfloat16 key/value updates.
evidence_boundary: The prior one-step smoke proved one inference call only. It did not exercise the autoregressively updated context and therefore did not establish sustained interaction.
